description: This Dart source file defines the AppProviders class which builds and returns a list of ChangeNotifierProviders for various app features such as settings, menu, cart, order, and reviews. It handles asynchronous initialization of shared preferences and local database instances to provide dependencies for the providers.

classes.name: AppProviders
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to asynchronously build and return a list of app-wide providers necessary for dependency injection in the Flutter app.

methods.name: build
methods.description: A static asynchronous method that initializes shared preferences and local database, then constructs and returns a list of ChangeNotifierProviders for app features.
